correctness.rationale: For h horizontal and v vertical edges of an induced matching, distinct row/column resources imply h+2v≤3t and 2h+v≤3t, hence h+v≤2t. Equality forces h=v=t and all resources saturated; each one-edge replacement is uniquely determined, proving freezing. For two removed horizontals/verticals there are five nontrivial resaturations apiece; for one of each eight, totaling 10*C(t,2)+8t²=13t²−5t. Row-only and column-only mixed swaps implement transpositions across a connected bipartite slot graph, proving connectivity for all t; independent row/column permutations prove transitivity. Independent fresh exhaustive state-graph BFS confirms 9 degree-8 states for t=1 and 8100 degree-42 states for t=2 with distance layers 1,42,705,4904,2448 (diameter 4). Only this finite diameter depends on enumeration.

value.rationale: Saturated maximum rook matchings form a natural finite reconfiguration space; proving the exact threshold between one-edge immobility and two-edge connectedness, together with all-order degree and transitivity, is a substantive structural theorem, even though the underlying packing count is old.

final_claim: For all t≥1, K_{3t} □ K_{3t} maximum induced matchings are frozen under one-edge swaps; the graph of exact simultaneous two-edge swaps is connected, transitive and degree 13t²−5t, with ((3t)!/(2^t t!))² states; t=2 diameter 4.
limitations: Only square rook graphs side divisible by three; no exact diameter for arbitrary t.
The t=2 diameter is fully finite exhaustive rather than a claimed closed all-t formula.
